name: aquelarre
description: A pane, a band and toasts that show the live coven project managers and what each one is doing

language.title: Language
language.description: The language of the pane, the band and the toasts: en (English) or es (Spanish).

band.title: Band
band.description: Show the one-line band above the prompt that sums up the project managers.

toasts.title: Toasts
toasts.description: Show a toast when a project manager asks a question, needs a production step, finishes or dies.
